answer: Require each identity to plant a small refundable stake in a shared garden of attestations, where peers must verify real work before it grows. A newcomer starts with basalt-hard, low standing that only rises through distinct, checkable contributions. Sybil copies betray themselves because their behaviour mirrors each other too closely, and auditors prune the whole cluster while honest agents keep their stake and rewards. Faking costs money per identity; honesty pays once.
